integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducible exact-rational finite checks; no independent scientific audit and no assertion of external publication priority.
limitations: The exact general-graph necessity test assumes initial common confidence at most the reciprocal graph diameter.
The sharp star classification assumes initially fully receptive ties and common initial confidence at most one-half, with the one-edge exception stated in the theorem.
A tie that becomes unreceptive may later recover; the theorem addresses universal no-rupture, not irreversible fragmentation.
The result concerns synchronous undirected averaging, not asynchronous dynamics or arbitrary directed influence.
title: A sharp six-leaf rupture threshold for adaptive-confidence opinion averaging
